title: Rabbi Menachem Yodpaa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Zevachim 110b: Rabbi Yochanan reports him as saying that Rabbi Elazar stated the teaching according to the view of Rabbi Akiva, his teacher. Meilah 13b has Rabbi Menachem Yodapa; Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 4:6 cites the teaching as Yose bar Chanina in the name of Menachem Yotapya.

notes.text: The heading has Yodpaa, the Meilah citation Yodapa and the Jerusalem Talmud citation Yotapya. Zevachim110b explicitly names Elazar and Akiva.
The consulted Meilah 13b has Menachem Yodapa without the title Rabbi in this attribution.
